text:
anya: Heads-up — assembling a compact launch pack for enterprise customers: 1) single-page Exec brief (for CISO/PD), 2) 1-page bench narrative (latency/cost tradeoffs by deploy mode), 3) webinar teaser + routing play. Goal: field-ready by EOW.

matt: love that. can we make the bench page show real numbers for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (typical P95 latency and $/1000 tokens)? even rough ballpark is helpful.

tara: yes — Ryan from infra shared sample perf matrix last sprint. I can pull avg P95 and cost multipliers. will add a tiny chart.

jordan: keep the exec page super simple: problem statement (security + SLAs), what we offer (hosted/dedicated/private), decision trigger (speed vs isolation vs cost), 1 recommended play for pilots. one column.

anya: agree. for messaging voice — be clear about: "same API, predictable economics, choice of isolation". avoid deep product detail. CX wants one call-to-action: schedule an architecture review.

matt: webinar teaser idea: "Benchmarks that matter: choosing a deploy mode for production LLMs" 20–30 min + customer Q&A. use the bench narrative as a slide.

jordan: routing play — when inbound comes in from demo request: 1) qualify (security/regulatory) 2) if regulated -> route to sales + solutions, request Private checklist; 3) if high throughput but no data isolation -> show Dedicated pricing + perf; 4) otherwise Hosted. short checklist for SDRs.

tara: drafting the bench numbers now. short aside — include a note about quantization/kv-caching assumptions (we used 4K context, batch optimizations on Dedicated). otherwise numbers will be misleading.

anya: yes add an assumptions footnote. also add a tiny risk note: "model quality tradeoffs with aggressive quantization" so legal/Sales know to flag.

matt: for visuals — keep two small graphics: a tradeoff triangle (latency/cost/isolation) and a mini-bar for P95 + $/1k tokens. I can sketch in Figma.

jordan: timeline: copy + numbers by Thu, Figma by Fri, review Mon. Webinar target Wed next week. good?

anya: sounds good. ownership: tara — bench numbers + assumptions; matt — figma and webinar slide deck; jordan — exec copy + routing play; anya — consolidate and final copy sign-off.

sam-bot: deploy-bench-report.pdf uploaded: https://files.redwood/reports/deploy-bench-report-1718.pdf (summary table included).

tara: grabbing that now, will cross-check and call out any deviations.

matt: jord — can you draft the CTA language for the one-pager? one sentence + link to calendar + "request architecture review" button.

jordan: draft: "Request an architecture review to map deploy mode, SLA, and controls to your compliance needs — schedule here: [cal.link/redwood-arch]". short and action-oriented. open to edits.

anya: perfect. last ask: can we bake in two micro-templates in the pack: 1) field email sequence (3 lines + link), 2) slide snippet for AE demos. makes adoption by sales faster.

matt: will add both templates in Figma as copy-ready components.

anya: awesome — thanks team. i'll assemble final JSON-ready one-pagers after sign-off so Solutions can drop into their portals. ping here when copy + figs are ready. :rocket:
